handler: cc (Opus) — owns this file and the final verdict. The worker computes and never edits it.

what_this_replaces.mainline: TOP-DOWN INDEX-LEVEL RIM. The August bottom-up constituent GAAP-book model is demoted to research and may not produce a public fair value.
what_this_replaces.why: The bottom-up model excluded 32 S&P 500 names for non-positive book — MCD, LOW, ABBV, PM, SBUX among them — because premium buybacks erase GAAP equity. Excluding a company from valuation because it returned capital is a defect of the spine, not a finding about the company.
what_this_replaces.old_valuation_range_v1: superseded. Its endpoints were RI fading to zero over ten years against RI growing forever at 2.5%, with no economic centre. Kept in the artifact as history, not consumed.

observed_inputs.rule: Read from the committed sources already wired into build-rim-index.mjs. No new estate.
observed_inputs.staleness_disclosure: The oldest binding input is the Damodaran ERP at 2026-04-01. Price, EPS, P/B and ROE are 2026-07-31 and the risk-free rate is 2026-08-05. Every artifact states the oldest input date beside the result.

derived.opening_book: B0 = price / price_to_book. SPX 1315.9252, NDX 3199.4885 by that identity.
derived.eps_path: E1/E2/E3 from the committed forecast_grid_v1. P2/P3 mechanical constituent forecasts are NOT used here — index consensus is the observed lane and the mechanical engine stays research.
derived.cost_of_equity: Ke_s = risk_free_rate + ERP_s. Broad US index beta is 1 by construction for a market risk-premium scenario. The GLS ICC may not be used as a discount rate at any point.

erp_grid.width_rationale: ±0.50pp, the spacing repeatedly used in the primary Kiwoom/Yoo public grids. The centre moves with the current Damodaran reading, so no historical absolute ERP level is copied.
erp_grid.mapping: ERP low is the bull required-return state, ERP high the bear state.

ltroe_grid.normalization_rule: median of the index ROE series over the trailing ten calendar years ending at the latest benchmark source date, after dropping non-finite values
ltroe_grid.measured_before_results: These bases were computed and written into this file before any valuation ran, so the grid carries no degree of freedom the result could move.
ltroe_grid.semantic_stability_check: Zero month-over-month ROE moves above 5pp across the full 2010-2026 series for either index, so the window is not spanning a definition change.

diagnostic_only.status: DIAGNOSTIC. Reported beside the primary grid, never substituted for it, and never selected after seeing a result. Note that the ±0.5pp primary grid is far narrower than this historical dispersion — that is a property of the Yoo-compatible grid and must be disclosed, not silently widened.

ltroe_grid.current_roe_is_not_ltroe: SPX 29.13% and NDX 41.40% are current readings and belong to FY1-FY3, not to perpetuity. Using them as the terminal ROE is prohibited.

payout.primary_route: A — index-weighted constituent dividend yield over index earnings yield
payout.cross_check_route: B — index-level published dividend yield over index earnings yield
payout.raw_divergence_is_a_warning_not_a_gate: The old contract hard-blocked NDX on a 15.783% raw payout-route divergence while the quantity the model actually consumes, retention, differed by 2.0148%. A gate that protects source agreement over product materiality blocks the wrong thing.

materiality_thresholds_frozen_before_res.ordering: Bear ≤ Base ≤ Bull must hold under both routes
materiality_thresholds_frozen_before_res.verdict_if_all_pass: payout_routes_materially_reconciled = true, render with a disclosed raw divergence
materiality_thresholds_frozen_before_res.verdict_if_any_fails: render both routes as separate scenarios for the owner and withhold any public state

explicit_period.note: Index-level roll-forward. The bottom-up OEA=0 failure does not transfer automatically: at index level the opening book is derived from observed P/B rather than summed GAAP equity, so buyback-driven equity destruction is already inside the observed P/B.

terminal.chosen: FENO canonical, zero-hidden-growth continuing residual income
terminal.formula: Terminal_RI_4 = (LTROE_s − Ke_s) × B3 ;  CV3 = Terminal_RI_4 / Ke_s
terminal.why_this_one: It makes LTROE − Ke the visible value driver and admits no hidden terminal-growth knob. Damodaran's point that terminal value is driven by excess return rather than growth in isolation is the reason.
terminal.honest_limit_recorded_at_freeze: E0 established that this formula is NOT what produced Yoo's published grids: it is linear in LTROE at fixed Ke, and the Murata 2019 grid is measurably convex in LTROE with its second step 3.4% larger than its first at all three discount rates. YOO_EXACT_EQUATION = NOT_VERIFIED. When a FENO number differs from a published Yoo figure, different terminal mathematics is the first explanation, and calibrating until they agree stays forbidden.
terminal.stable_growth_variant: NOT computed in the primary grid. Permitted only as a labelled sensitivity and only if a g_stable with independent provenance is frozen separately.

scenario_grid.axes: ERP {low, base, high} × LTROE {low, base, high}
scenario_grid.GRID_MEAN: arithmetic mean of all nine cells
scenario_grid.base_is_required: Base is the explicit centre cell and must be rendered and labelled. Suppressing a middle scenario because it might be quoted as a target is the wrong product policy; an unlabelled oracle is what is forbidden, not a labelled centre.
scenario_grid.base_is_not: the median of unrelated model families, an average chosen after results, or anything calibrated to the current price

assertions: at fixed LTROE, lower ERP must not lower value
at fixed ERP, higher LTROE must not lower value
monotonicity_hard_gate.on_violation: hard fail — no owner-facing number is produced from a non-monotone surface

solve: LTROE that sets V0 equal to the current price at ERP_BASE
ERP that sets V0 equal to the current price at LTROE_BASE
reverse_implied.report: bounds, convergence, and the solved value; non-convergence is reported as non-convergence and never as a bound
reverse_implied.alarms_are_not_anchors: A tripped alarm marks the result for explanation. It never moves Base, and reverse-implied output may not retune any scenario input.

hard_blockers: price, EPS or P/B units impossible
any source date in the future
handler cannot independently reproduce the arithmetic
any calibration to current price or to a Yoo output
soft_qa_does_not_block_visibility: payout routes disagreeing while value impact is bounded

qqq.label: NDX-ratio indicative equivalent
qqq.prohibited: calling it a reconstructed ETF NAV fair value
qqq.caveats: expense ratio and tracking difference are disclosed and do not block the number

prohibitions: no calibration to the current price or to any Yoo published output
no terminal growth chosen to reproduce a target
no scenario assumption changed after seeing output
no same-date GLS ICC as a discount rate
no new model family — this reset is the last mainline family change
no automatic public promotion on READY
no editing of this file; supersede with -v2 and a new receipt

publication.owner_research_preview: always allowed once the hard blockers pass, whatever the confidence label
publication.public_surface: PUBLIC_ROWS = [] and PUBLIC_STATE = MODEL_REVALIDATION remain until a separate owner approval. READY does not auto-promote.

verification_protocol.worker: computes, then switches to a verifier role and recomputes by a structurally different route, and states what it would not defend
verification_protocol.handler: rebuilds all nine cells for both indices from the observed inputs with independent code before any number reaches the owner, and checks monotonicity mechanically rather than by inspection

why_v2_exists.defect: v1 stated the rule 'LTROE_HIGH = LTROE_BASE + 0.005' and then tabulated NDX high as 0.31810, which is base + 0.010. A transcription error against the file's own rule. SPX was correct at 0.22480.
why_v2_exists.which_governs: The rule. It is stated twice in v1 and again in the architecture plan section 4.3 and the execution contract section 8.3, all as plus or minus 0.5pp. The tabulated number was the outlier.
why_v2_exists.direction_of_the_correction: It NARROWS the bull case. NDX BULL falls from 21412 to 21082 and the grid mean from 19581 to 19477. A correction that makes the optimistic corner less optimistic cannot be output targeting.
why_v2_exists.no_result_dependence: The worker computed from the rule, not the tabulated number, before any handler number existed, and independently produced 21082.01. The corrected value is what the rule always required rather than something chosen after seeing an outcome.
why_v2_exists.handler_disclosure: I published NDX BULL 21412 and grid mean 19581 to the owner from my own run before catching this. Both were wrong and are corrected in the same message that reports the diff. This is my error, not the worker's.
why_v2_exists.affected_numbers_only: NDX bull cell, NDX grid mean, and the QQQ bull leg derived from them. SPX is untouched and every SPX cell matched the worker to under 0.005 index points.
